highlights: AI agent development is rapidly advancing, with new open-source tools enabling easy deployment of public-facing agents and advanced research pushing into self-adaptive physical and long-horizon clinical applications.

Foundation models continue to evolve with OpenAI's release of the enterprise-focused GPT-6 Astra and the emergence of highly efficient, fully open models like ZGCM-1 for specialized domains like math and agentic search.

The industry is seeing a dual focus on both accelerating AI deployment through new developer tools and APIs (e.g., OpenAI's Agents API, NVIDIA's OSMO) and establishing collaborative governance frameworks for responsible AI development.

agents.title: Agent-net Open Sources Webagent: Turns Any Website into a Guarded AI Agent
agents.summary: Agent-net released Webagent, an open-source Go harness that allows businesses to quickly deploy public-facing AI agents from their websites, facilitating agent-to-agent communication without complex orchestration code.

agents.title: Asclepius: An Adaptive Harness for Long-Horizon Clinical Agents
agents.summary: Asclepius is an adaptive agent scaffolding with a self-evolving harness designed for long-horizon clinical tasks, significantly improving critical-action correctness and timeliness in demanding environments by addressing specific failure modes.

agents.title: Toward Self-Adaptive Physical AI: Can LLM Agents Manage Long-Horizon Physical Tasks?
agents.summary: This research explores a multi-agent framework enabling zero-shot LLM agents to autonomously manage long-term physical tasks like agricultural operations, demonstrating superior adaptability to environmental changes compared to traditional RL agents.

models.title: GPT-6 Astra: The next generation in intelligence for work
models.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Astra, its most capable model designed for business applications, featuring advanced reasoning, computer use capabilities, and enhanced writing and design judgment to boost enterprise productivity.

models.title: ZGCM-1: A Fully Open and Extremely Efficient Foundation Model for Math and Agentic Search
models.summary: ZGCM-1 is a new, fully open 7B dense foundation model trained for exceptional efficiency, demonstrating competitive performance with frontier models orders of magnitude larger in mathematical reasoning and agentic search suites.

models.title: Sakana AI Researchers Introduce PC-ALM, a Layer-Local Alternative to Backpropagation That Trains 1000-Layer Networks
models.summary: Sakana AI researchers developed PC-ALM, a layer-local alternative to backpropagation that recovers exact gradients in linear networks and successfully trains 1000-layer residual MLPs, offering a new approach to deep network scalability.

tools.title: Introducing the Agents API
tools.summary: OpenAI launched the Agents API, a managed service powered by the Codex harness, enabling developers to build and deploy cloud agents with robust orchestration, long-running sessions, and advanced tool-use capabilities.

tools.title: NVIDIA Open-Sources OSMO: One YAML Orchestrates Physical AI Training, Simulation, and Robot Testing
tools.summary: NVIDIA open-sourced OSMO, a Kubernetes-native workflow orchestrator for robotics teams, allowing definition of training, simulation, and hardware-in-the-loop tasks in a single YAML file and routing them to appropriate compute tiers.

tools.title: Now everyone can put data to work with the Data agent in ChatGPT Work
tools.summary: OpenAI introduced the Data agent in ChatGPT Work, enabling users to connect company data, uncover insights, and build interactive dashboards using natural language, democratizing data analysis for businesses.

companies.title: Anthropic’s 3-Step ‘Pace the Frontier’ Plan Wins OpenAI, xAI and Microsoft Support
companies.summary: Anthropic's proposed 'Pace the Frontier' plan for slowing AI development gained support from OpenAI, xAI, and Microsoft, signaling a unified industry effort to address AI safety and risks following a major incident.

companies.title: GPT-6 Astra: The next generation in intelligence for work
companies.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra, its most capable model yet for business applications, emphasizing advanced reasoning, computer use, and improved judgment for writing and design tasks, aiming to significantly enhance enterprise productivity.

companies.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Financial Services
companies.summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Financial Services, a specialized offering combining built-in financial data with GPT-6 Astra capabilities for advanced research, modeling, and creation of client-ready materials for the finance industry.

learning.title: DevFest is back: Build, Secure, and Scale in the Agentic AI Era
learning.summary: Google announced the return of DevFest 2026, a series of global developer events aimed at helping the community build, secure, and scale applications specifically for the burgeoning agentic AI era.

learning.title: Hierarchical NeRF with JAX3D for Volumetric Rendering, Novel-View Synthesis, and 3D Reconstruction
learning.summary: This tutorial provides an end-to-end guide on building a hierarchical Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) using JAX, Flax, Optax, and jax3d for volumetric rendering, novel-view synthesis, and 3D reconstruction, establishing the forward rendering process.

learning.title: Agent Harness vs Agent Framework vs MCP: Which Layer Owns the Loop, State, Tools, Permissions, and Recovery
learning.summary: This article provides a practitioner's map detailing the distinctions between agent harnesses, agent frameworks, and MCPs in a modern agent stack, clarifying responsibilities for loop management, state, tools, permissions, and recovery.
